title: Phase 7a's status header contradicts its implementation record
claim: The Phase 7a header says it is a draft pending critic and user review, while the same document records implemented commit boundaries and user-approved activation; the parent plan also marks the phase complete with approved assumptions.

title: The parent plan overstates the one-byte exclusion
claim: The parent plan says the first version does not track one-byte values, but the Phase 5 plan permits one-byte derived windows from an existing managed root. The documented behavior needs to distinguish new one-byte managed roots from derived one-byte windows.
